newsitem.title: USA: GTECH wins Oregon lottery contract.
newsitem.headline: GTECH wins Oregon lottery contract.

text.p: GTECH Corp said it signed a contract to provide on-line services and equipment to the Oregon lottery.

GTECH will replace the lottery's existing on-line system and provide other services, including system and terminal installation, maintenance and marketing support. The system will be operated by GTECH from a new data center.
The seven-year facilities management contract can be extended by the lottery for up to three additional years.
GTECH also said the Illinois lottery has extended its contract by two years to October 1999.
